newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Yasser Arafat to visit Sri Lanka soon - radio.
newsitem.headline: Yasser Arafat to visit Sri Lanka soon - radio.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is expected to visit Sri Lanka soon, state radio said on Wednesday.
The Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation said Arafat would be accompanied by a high-powered delegation and hold official talks with Sri Lankan President Chandrika Kumaratunga.
The radio did not give any dates for Arafat' visit, but diplomatic sources said he was likely to arrive in Colombo early next week.
Arafat is currently embroiled in a major diplomatic row with Israel over Tel Aviv's decision to build a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
